portfolio_v3.market_rationale: Wide observed active-return spreads suggest high dispersion despite the missing aggregate dispersion statistic. Weak breadth, expensive financing and elevated energy prices argue against indiscriminate risk-taking, while stable employment limits the recession case. Selective quality-pullback reversals look more credible than extrapolating technology or crypto gains. Inflation, the FOMC and employment releases can materially change leadership before October 12.
